item: G101 Git 收斂 increment 1: per-generation shared snapshot + event invalidation + affected scope
changes: git_tiers/generation_snapshot.py (new): GenerationSnapshot — head_oid/branch/upstream/ahead/behind/dirty/fingerprint/changed/staged/unstaged paths + affected_scope + status_map from ONE 'status --porcelain=v2 -z --branch' + one 'diff --numstat HEAD' per capture; zero-subprocess probe (.git HEAD ref content + index sha256 + packed-refs/MERGE_HEAD stat) keyed per worktree; post-capture re-probe so git status's own index refresh never self-invalidates; notify_changed() event invalidation; scope_of() mapping (Standalone tools/<tool>, .worktrees/<name>, top-level dir, (root))
self_commit.py: run_once/_run_once_unlocked accept shared snapshot (skips duplicate porcelain read); notify_changed after successful commit; commit subject now names affected scopes

git_automation.py: sweep consumes generation_snapshot per worktree (fingerprint keeps numstat semantics so debounce contract unchanged) and passes it to run_once — one capture per worktree per tick instead of status+porcelain; sweep state records affected_scope
workspace_sync.py: per-worktree dirty check reads the shared snapshot (max_age_s=0 hard freshness) instead of a separate status call
tests: git_tiers/tests/test_generation_snapshot.py: 10/10 — fields, dirty paths + scope mapping, cache reuse, probe-change recapture, notify_changed invalidation, TTL-0 hard freshness, dirty-edit TTL aging, non-worktree, scope_of mapping, staged/unstaged split
test_self_commit.py::test_commit_lease_defers_sweep standalone PASS (50s; slow but green — xdist worker kill is a pre-existing environment issue)
real-repo smoke: capture 1.78s → cached 0.000s; dirty=True, scopes=(root, local-model, governance_rule, main-system, shared-layer)
deferred: filesystem watcher (ReadDirectoryChangesW) for external writes — dirty edits between ticks still rely on sweep cadence (probe only covers .git metadata); notify_changed covers in-process writers now
queue-event-driven sync trigger (merge-queue writes waking the sync cycle before the 300s interval)
per-scope commit splitting — debounce already batches a task's stable changes into one commit; splitting by affected_scope is a larger behavior change needing its own increment
notes: freshness contract: probe covers commits/staging/checkouts (0-subprocess); pure worktree edits are TTL-bounded — correctness gates pass max_age_s=0, the 60s sweep passes its interval. ahead/behind come free from porcelain branch.ab.
